To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a contextual model-based anomaly detection approach for the detection of malicious voltage control attacks is proposed, (ii) the proposed approach is tested in a realistic simulation environment, and (iii) the results show that the proposed approach outperforms point anomaly detection in the detection of malicious actions.

the proposed contextual anomaly detection approach can detect the control actions of distributed energy resources with an average accuracy of 95.2% and detect malicious control actions with an average accuracy 95.3%.
the contextual anomaly detector is able to detect a malicious control action of an intruder with an accuracy of over 99% and with an average detection latency of 1.2 s.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following research questions: What is the performance of the contextual anomaly detection method in detecting malicious voltage control attacks compared to the point anomaly detection?
the development and evaluation of anomaly detection techniques to identify cyber-physical threats and attacks in Smart Grids.
the development of a novel approach to the anomaly detection in cyber-physical systems, with a special emphasis on the Smart Grid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the contextual anomaly detector is a promising method for detecting malicious control actions in a low-voltage distribution network.
the contextual anomaly detector is able to detect the malicious voltage control actions of a smart meter in a distribution grid, while the point anomaly detector is not.
the proposed contextual anomaly detection is more effective than a point anomaly detection for the discovery of malicious control actions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the contextual anomaly detector is able to identify malicious actions in the low-voltage distribution grid, and the contextual approach is more effective in identifying malicious actions compared to the point anomaly approach.
the contextual anomaly detector is able to identify the malicious control actions in the Smart Grids.
the contextual anomaly approach is a more robust and efficient method than the point anomaly detection for cyber security in Smart Grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method provides better results in the detection of malicious voltage control attacks in the low voltage grid than the existing point anomaly detection methods.
the contextual anomaly approach outperforms the point anomaly approach in detecting malicious control actions.

the contextual anomaly detector can be used to detect malicious control actions in the Smart Grid, and the anomaly detection is more efficient when the control actions are contextualised with respect to the behaviour of a distributed energy resource.
